controls.label: Color
controls.qualification: Whole-disc color from a published reflectance spectrum and V geometric albedo, painted uniformly; the surface itself is unresolved.
controls.notes: A sphere at the measured diameter; no shape model is published. One mean color for the whole disc (Gaia DR3 reflectance spectrum), scaled to the 2.2% geometric albedo JPL lists; no terrain, albedo pattern or color variation is drawn.
